thread:
aldo_release: Quick alert - tonight's coordinated push at 21:45PDT: runtime v1.8.5 (small KV/latency fixes), router header-normalize flag, console minimal contract change. We plan API pinned to v2.3.2 for canary. Confirm readiness?

min_runtime: runtime build green. KV tweak might change eviction order slightly; will enable KV_ORDER_STABLE=true for canary and emit runtime.kv.order_jitter. Recommend 5m soak.

tara_console: console contract adds optional request_origin header. Backwards compatible but some parsers assumed header present. I'll add defensive parsing.

lev_router: header-normalize will trim and lowercase certain headers. I'll gate with flag router-normalize-7135 on canary routers only. Synthetic header tests added.

kim_qe: I'll run quick header+ingestion matrix in staging with API pinned. ETA 10m.

aldo_release: Canary cadence: 15% for 10m -> 40% for 20m -> full. Rollback triggers: p95 +25ms OR error rate >0.6% sustained 5m OR ingestion 5xx spike.

deploybot: @channel Deploybot will start canary in ~8m. Snapshot: runtime:v1.8.5, router:flag=router-normalize-7135(canary), console:v1.5.9-contract, api:v2.3.2-pinned. Preflight: unit + schema-smoke. Logs -> #release-logs.

kim_qe: started matrix. Seeing intermittent parser errors in console canary: "ParserError: missing request_origin" in analytics worker. Stack shows ConsoleParser.java:86.

tara_console: hmm our defensive parsing didn't land on the deployed rev. Looks like console was built without the fallback patch in the canary image. Hold canary. Rollback console to v1.5.8 in canary.

deploybot: Rolling back console in canary to v1.5.8 now. Pausing traffic progression.

min_runtime: monitoring canary metrics. No p95 spike yet but ingestion 5xxs ticked during initial push.

aldo_release: Do not progress to 40%. Actions: 1) ensure console build contains fallback; 2) add requirement to release checklist: enforce API pin in console deploy spec and verify artifact SHA; 3) add 'header-normalize-smoke' to preflight; 4) runtime soak step. I'll open follow-ups.

deploybot: console rollback complete in canary. Traffic frozen at 15% for API/runtime only. Notifying @release-team.
